title: Attribute provenance envelope
description: Every value inside an entity's `attributes` JSONB column is wrapped in this envelope (entity-model.md §2). Never write a bare scalar.

value.description: The inferred or provided value. null is explicitly a valid answer when evidence is absent — code must not invent a value to satisfy validation (phase1-llm-boundary.md §2).

run_id.description: The agent_runs.id that produced this value. null for non-LLM sources (e.g. provider data).
